Maxi Hopper

Code: MXHP

In Etherlords and Etherlords II

Maxi Hopper is unaffected by summoning sickness, the opponent randomly discards 2 spells after being hit by Maxi Hopper. At the end of turn if there are 3 or more creatures in graveyard above Maxi Hopper, return Maxi Hopper into play
